procedural_matters: Hearing # 11 & 12 were reopened under 63.7(a)(3) from significant new information brought by the protestor within 24 hours of the incident.
facts: 194228 misidentified the race #s on protest forms # 11 and 12. Originally submitted as races 4 & 5 while the incidents occurred in races 5 & 6.
conclusions: The protests did not identify the respective incidents as required by RRS 60.3(a).
decision: Protests 11 & 12 are invalid, 225325 is to be reinstated in races 4 & 5
